**Dedupe is in.** 99 repeats now drop, 0 errors.

`route()` checks `state.lastSentAt` first. A key sent under 5 minutes ago drops. Only real sends update the clock, so a dropped repeat does not extend the window. `createState()` now returns a `Map`.

| priority | day | quiet |
|---|---|---|
| low | `email` 111 | `queue` 90 |
| normal | `push` 112 | `queue` 88 |
| high | `sms`+`email` 112 | `queue` 88 |
| critical | `pager` 112 | `pager` 88 |

Next: nothing. I count a `queue` write as a send. Tell me if queued items should not block a later repeat.
